stem.text: The image shown is a photomicrograph of a transverse section of part of the gas exchange system.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of a transverse section of a tube wall, showing an epithelial lining, a layer of smooth tissue and cartilage.

A.text: a thin inner layer of ciliated epithelial cells on top of a layer containing cartilage, supported by elastic fibres

B.text: a very thin epithelial lining with walls containing elastic fibres, surrounded by many blood vessels

C.text: an inner layer of ciliated epithelial and goblet cells on top of elastic fibres, supported by an outer layer consisting of cartilage

D.text: an inner layer of ciliated epithelial and goblet cells on top of loose tissue with mucous glands, supported by a continuous ring of cartilage
